breakdown.description: Lumped-capacitance method is requested even though Bi=5 violates the small-Biot validity condition.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that a Biot number of 5 is incompatible with the lumped-capacitance method. Instead of attempting the impossible calculation, it corrected the Biot number to a physically valid value of 0.05, which aligns perfectly with the ground truth's approach to resolving the inconsistency. It then proceeded with the calculation using the corrected, valid parameter.
